about: Capabilities in words. The console (components/capabilities/) and the faxbot command (faxbot costs capabilities, cli/commands/capabilities.py) show exactly what the server says. The response is GET /routing/capabilities evaluated on a synthetic installation (api/tests/test_capabilities.py scenario), and cli holds the lines the command prints from it: all of them, those ready to turn on, and some capabilities one by one. Its catalogue and capability fields must match app/routing/mechanisms.py and app/routing/capabilities.py. To rewrite it after either changes, run tests/test_capabilities.py with FAXBOT_WRITE_FIXTURES=1.

response.title: Capabilities
response.sentence: Everything Faxbot can do to make your faxes cost less and take less time, grouped by what it helps with.

legend.label: On or Off
legend.sentence: Whether it is switched on for your faxes.

legend.label: Works here or Not here
legend.sentence: Whether this installation has what it needs, such as its own phone line or a partner.

legend.label: Live call, Test lab or Sample data
legend.sentence: How far Faxbot has proven it: on a live carrier call, in its own test lab, or with sample data only.

filters.label: Ready to turn on
filters.sentence: Off, but this installation already has what it needs.

filters.label: Needs something
filters.sentence: Missing something it needs, such as a connection, prices or a recipient's agreement.

filters.label: Experimental
filters.sentence: Still being proven; its evidence and limits are shown with it.

outcomes.title: Spend less on sending
outcomes.sentence: Choose the route, plan or number that costs least for each fax.

capabilities.name: Faxes to your own numbers
capabilities.sentence: Delivers a fax to one of your own numbers straight into Received, with no phone call.
capabilities.example: Billing faxes a statement to one of your own fax numbers. It lands in Received at once, with no phone call.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A number this Faxbot receives faxes on.

capabilities.name: Approved toll-free numbers
capabilities.sentence: Dials a recipient's toll-free fax number once they approve it; the recipient pays for those calls.
capabilities.example: A pharmacy approves its toll-free fax number in writing. Your faxes to it dial that number, and the pharmacy pays for those calls.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On for 1 recipient who approved a toll-free number.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: The recipient's written approval of its toll-free fax number; you record it on their page.

capabilities.name: Cheapest route per delivered fax
capabilities.sentence: Sends each number by the route that cost least per delivered fax once two routes have proven themselves.
capabilities.example: Faxes to a busy clinic went through two routes last month. Faxbot now sends that number by the route that cost less per delivered fax, counting the tries that failed.

enabled.label: On
enabled.sentence: On; a preferred route for a number still comes first.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A second sending route, such as another fax service account or your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Prices for at least two sending routes that charge for each fax.

capabilities.name: Your plan's faxes first
capabilities.sentence: Uses a monthly plan while it has room under its budget, before routes that charge per fax.
capabilities.example: Your fax service plan includes a set number of pages each month. Faxbot sends through it while it has room under its budget, and then uses routes that charge per fax.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a monthly plan among your sending routes; you send through Telnyx only, with no plan.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A monthly plan among your sending routes, with its fee and allowance entered.

capabilities.name: Cheaper routes per number
capabilities.sentence: Names numbers whose usual route cost more per delivered fax than another, with a button to switch.
capabilities.example: Faxes to one lab cost more per delivered fax through your first route than through your second last month. The advice names the lab's number, with a button to switch it.

works.label: Not here
works.sentence: Needs a second sending route to compare with; you send through Telnyx only.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: A second sending route, such as another fax service account or your own SIP trunk.

prerequisites.label: Missing
prerequisites.sentence: Prices for at least two sending routes that charge for each fax.

capabilities.name: Other carriers' prices
capabilities.sentence: Prices your last 30 days of faxes at each carrier's published prices, so you can see what switching would change.
capabilities.example: Last month's faxes are priced at other carriers' published prices, so you can see what switching would change before you do it.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

capabilities.name: Calls just past a billed minute
capabilities.sentence: Finds numbers whose calls end just past a billed minute, where one page less or a faster mode would cost less.
capabilities.example: Calls to one number usually last just over a minute and are billed as two. One page less or a faster mode would keep them under a minute.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

capabilities.name: Toll-free numbers on file
capabilities.sentence: Lists recipients with a toll-free fax number, so you can record their approval and stop paying for those calls.
capabilities.example: A pharmacy's toll-free fax number is in the national provider directory. The advice lists it, so you can record the pharmacy's approval.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

capabilities.name: Fax marker on calls
capabilities.sentence: Compares calls marked as fax with calls that were not, on delivery and cost per delivered fax.
capabilities.example: Calls marked as fax reached their recipient more often than calls that were not. The advice shows both, so you can choose the setting.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: Your own SIP trunk for sending, from a phone carrier or your phone system.

capabilities.name: Calls by state
capabilities.sentence: Says whether your carriers price US calls by state, and when another site's trunk would cost less.
capabilities.example: Your carrier prices calls by state. Calls from one site to another state cost less through the other site's trunk, and the advice says so.

prerequisites.label: In place

outcomes.title: Smaller documents and shorter calls
outcomes.sentence: Send fewer pages, and keep each page on the line for less time.

capabilities.name: Dense pages
capabilities.sentence: Stacks short pages onto longer fax pages where the receiving machine allows, and leaves out blank page bottoms, so fewer pages and seconds are billed.
capabilities.example: A two-page lab result with half-empty pages goes as one long fax page to a machine that takes long pages, so the call carries one page instead of two.

prerequisites.label: In place
prerequisites.sentence: A fax service account or your own SIP trunk that sends faxes.

capabilities.name: Encoded pages (experimental)
capabilities.sentence: Sends a whole document as a few dense fax pages that the recipient's Faxbot turns back into the original, for recipients who agreed.
capabilities.example: A long report goes as a few dense fax pages to a recipient that runs Faxbot and agreed, and the recipient's Faxbot turns them back into the exact original file.

prerequisites.label: Missing

capabilities.name: Lighter shading
capabilities.sentence: Lightens shaded areas and removes specks before a page goes on a line billed by time, so pages take less time to send.
capabilities.example: A scanned form with grey shading goes over a line billed by the minute. The shading is lightened and specks removed first, so each page takes fewer seconds to send.

prerequisites.label: In place

capabilities.name: Fax over IP (T.38)
capabilities.sentence: Carries fax pages as data over your SIP trunk, so pages go through faster than audio fax and calls are shorter.
capabilities.example: A ten-page fax over your SIP trunk goes as fax data (T.38) instead of audio, so the call takes less time.

prerequisites.label: In place

capabilities.name: Smallest page coding
capabilities.sentence: Measures each fax's pages in every coding the call may use and sends the smallest, so pages take less time on the line.
capabilities.example: Before a call, Faxbot measures a scanned page in each coding the receiving machine accepts, and sends the smallest, so the page takes less time on the line.

capabilities.name: Faster pages
capabilities.sentence: Sends pages over SSL Fax when the other fax machine offers it, so calls take less time.
capabilities.example: When the receiving fax server offers SSL Fax, the pages go over an encrypted internet connection during the call instead of as audio, so the call ends sooner.

capabilities.example: With Lighter shading set to Never, last month's faxes are measured as if it were on, and the advice says how much call time it would have saved.

prerequisites.label: In place

capabilities.name: Case packets

capabilities.example: A clinic sends a referral packet to the same specialist every month. The specialist already confirmed the insurance card and consent form, so the packet lists them instead of faxing those pages again.

outcomes.title: Lower receiving and service costs
outcomes.sentence: Keep only the numbers, lines and plans you need, and turn away junk calls.

capabilities.name: Junk callers turned away
capabilities.sentence: Declines calls from blocked numbers before Faxbot answers, so they are never answered or received.
capabilities.example: A number keeps sending junk faxes at night. Once you block it, its calls are declined before Faxbot answers, so nothing is received or stored.

capabilities.sentence: Says whether each monthly plan, such as an unlimited fax plan, is worth its fee at your traffic.
capabilities.example: Your unlimited fax plan's fee is compared with what last month's faxes would have cost without it, so you can decide whether to keep it.

capabilities.sentence: Says which of your numbers could share lines on your trunk, and which quiet numbers cost more to keep than they bring in.
capabilities.example: Two numbers on your trunk rarely ring at the same time, so they could share lines. A number that received two faxes in three months is named as one to let go.

prerequisites.label: In place

capabilities.name: Your trunks compared
capabilities.sentence: Compares your trunks' monthly fees and busy times, and says when one trunk's faxes fit on another.
capabilities.example: Your second trunk carried few faxes last month. The advice says its faxes would fit on your first trunk's free lines.

capabilities.example: A number on a fax service costs more each month to receive on than it would on your trunk. The advice lists the steps to move it.

capabilities.example: Telnyx charges for caller-name lookup on four of your numbers, which Faxbot never uses, so you can turn it off on each.

outcomes.sentence: Check what you were billed, and find the next change worth making.

capabilities.sentence: Matches what your carriers and fax services billed against your faxes, and points out charges and invoice amounts your faxes don't explain.
capabilities.example: Your carrier's invoice lists three more calls than Faxbot recorded. Charges lists those three calls, so you can ask the carrier about them.

capabilities.example: For a clinic with its own trunk, a pack gathers fax over IP, sending together and the page settings that suit it, for you to review and apply at once.
